text:
Anna (Finance): heads-up — ACH attempt for INV-2025-0097 ($36,480) failed this morning, bank returned 'insufficient_funds'.
Anna (Finance): payment window was EOM, so now officially past due.
Pioneer Billing Bot: Automatic notice sent to billing@pioneer-analytics.com for INV-2025-0097 (due 2026-02-28).
Sam (AM): ok gonna ping the account — Priya are they aware? any context on usage spike?
Priya (Pioneer Billing): yes, they're aware. We had a big ingestion job last week, cashflow hiccup. Customer (Pioneer) asked if we can accept a short payment plan.
Anna (Finance): we can consider but need at least a 25% payment today to stop dunning and a signed plan for the remainder.
Priya (Pioneer Billing): can do 25% today and then 3 weekly installments over March. They requested no extra late fees if we set it up.
Lina (Collections Lead): we can waive one late fee as a courtesy if they commit in writing. need email confirmation from their finance lead + payment schedule. hold escalation for 5 business days once first payment posts.
Marta (Legal): we don't need a full MSA amendment for <$50k, an email acceptance with schedule and a payment reference is OK. I'll draft a short confirmation template.
Raj (Support): FYI customer also reported an invoice mismatch on line item 3 — usage shows 12,400 tokens but their internal shows 12,000. Could cause pushback if we push too hard.
Anna (Finance): include a reconciliation note in the email to avoid surprises. Also provide a payment link (card or ACH) — customer prefers ACH.
Priya (Pioneer Billing): sending proposed email to the customer now (cc'ing legal). snippet: ```Hi Finance Team — we can do 25% now ($9,120) and 3 weekly payments of $9,120 starting 2026-03-06. Please confirm by reply and include bank transfer ref. Once we receive first payment we will suspend dunning and waive one late fee. Regards, Priya```
Priya (Pioneer Billing): customer replied: "Ok, confirming — will initiate ACH for $9,120 today, will send payment ref once posted"
Pioneer Billing Bot: Payment received notification pending — awaiting bank confirmation (1-2 business days).
Lina (Collections Lead): great. hold escalation. If bank doesn't clear by 1765070000 (next Fri) we re-open dunning and escalate to Ops + Legal.
Anna (Finance): I'll mark invoice as 'pending plan' in billing dashboard and set note to auto-cancel late notice.
Sam (AM): thanks team — I'll keep loop closed and update if the reconciliation dispute requires adjustment. :thumbsup:
Marta (Legal): uploaded short confirmation template to thread: please use exact wording to avoid ambiguity.
Priya (Pioneer Billing): copied. will send final email with wording and cc legal.
Anna (Finance): resolved for now. track until payment clears and then record WAIVED_LATE_FEE tag.
Priya (Pioneer Billing): will post bank ref when available.
Pioneer Billing Bot: Thread closed automatically after payment confirmation. (will reopen on non-payment)
